ignisNote: The strongest leverage on a mature site (SIL 959, S220) was not net-new surface but deepening the agent-legibility of the surface that already gets the most traffic: the hero JSON-LD was technically present but informationally bare. The pattern to keep: enrich dual-audience structured data from source-of-truth only (never the clock or hand-seeds, so --check stays deterministic), neutralise injection in embedded JSON, and lock the shape with a parse-and-assert gate so the enrichment can't silently rot. Also: an imported-by-nothing orphan that is byte-identical to a sibling repo's canonical copy is debris to remove, not a carry to allowlist forever.
